RECORD SHOP, CINEMA TWEAKS & MORE. UPDATE 001 IS LIVE.

Mates,

Convict has updated my hip hop stoner noir and it's fing sweet.

1. RECORD SHOP ON WORLD MAP
After high demand, there's now a record shop on the world map so you can choose your poison and enjoy our amazing licensed tracks. Enjoy some hip hop, electronic or pop at your own leisure.

2. CINEMA TWEAKS
Did someone say fullscreen cinema. It's in mates and the cinema's busier nowadays too. 
Death of cinema, my koala butt.

3. NEW SPLASH SCREEN
I got a new close up, and I'm looking pretty fine if I can say so myself.

4. BUG FIXES
So yeah, my story had a few bugs here and there. 
We fixed as many as possible. I'm a koala, bugs is part of life right? :)

5. MENU SOUNDS
Vinyl sounds mate. 
A little touch I demanded from those geniuses at Convict Games.


Enjoy mates and lots of love from your hairy, handsome koala mate.

Yours always,

STONE
Koala PI
